verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing's REST API is well documented for creating/updating cards, managing balance accounts, transaction rules, and viewing card payments/webhooks — covering most of the 'API' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of an MCP surface for agent access, and no explicit documentation of scoped/granular API credentials for restricting an agent's permissions. missing for 10: MCP server/tool surface, scoped API-key/permission model documentation, explicit transaction/balance read endpoints beyond Customer Area UI mentions.
